headline: A'ja Wilson, Kelsey Plum to miss the FIBA Women's World Cup
description: Kelsey Plum and A'ja Wilson will miss the FIBA Women's World Cup for health reasons, with the Mercury announcing that Plum will miss the rest of the 2026 season. Kiki Iriafen and Sonia Citron will replace Plum and Wilson, USA Basketball announced Monday.

headline: Angel Reese breaks WNBA record with 29th double-double
